source.publisher: Northern Whig (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names read on the block image of the Northern Whig nominations report of 14 May 1927; the Ballycultra withdrawal is reported in the same paper on 12 May 1927

note: Triennial election of the Castlereagh rural district councillors. A contest was threatened in Ballycultra, but Mr. J. H. Murphy withdrew, so all nine divisions were returned unopposed and there was no poll. Filed on the rural districts' polling day, Thursday 2 June 1927 (queue nominal 26 May). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
